notes.text: Dated Massy le 18.5.1971, addressed Cher Verdier. The writer discusses the reissue of SGA 4, Saavedra's index for Chap IV, par.9 à 13, and the two Deligne appendices described as assez, de points and image inverse d'un plat; he asks whether Verdier can send them for typing.
notes.basis: Observed date, salutation and paragraph 1 lines 1–7; no external identification or reconstruction.

notes.text: The writer asks for a corrected version of exercice 4.10.6 (médaille chocolat), says he has forgotten what was canulé, and seeks something true to replace the false. No mathematical assertion or repair is supplied or verified on this page.
notes.basis: Observed paragraph 1 lines 8–13; transcription alone, with no proof check.

notes.text: The second paragraph requests instructions on finishing SGA 4, states a preference for leaving it incomplet et dégueulasse over spending time away from boulot survie, and asks Artin what to do with the exposés after VI and the packet of errata/footnotes/améliorations notes.
notes.basis: Observed paragraph 2; no inference about the notes on other sheets.

notes.text: Visible irregularities are retained: comma in assez, de points; pourlla; canulé; two circumflexes in plûtôt; no separator between footnotes and améliorations. The dashes in paragraph 2 are single plain source strokes: H's -- is treated as a typographical encoding of the same dash, and H's \ldots as the same three dots; neither is counted as a substantive collation difference. H's guillemets do differ from the observed double quotation marks.
